gloss: same-day ticket; day ticket; door ticket

definitions.gloss: same-day ticket; day ticket; door ticket
definitions.explanation: a ticket purchased on the day of the event, as opposed to tickets bought in advance

examples.japanese: {当日券|とうじつけん}は{売|う}り{切|き}れだった。
examples.english: The same-day tickets were sold out.

examples.japanese: {当日券|とうじつけん}は{前売|まえう}りより{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Same-day tickets are more expensive than advance tickets.

examples.japanese: {当日券|とうじつけん}を{求|もと}めて{朝|あさ}から{並|なら}んだ。
examples.english: I lined up from the morning to get same-day tickets.

notes:
FORMATION:
{当日|とうじつ} (same day) + {券|けん} (ticket)

PRICING:
{当日券|とうじつけん} is typically priced higher than {前売|まえう}り{券|けん} (advance tickets), often by 500-1000 yen.

AVAILABILITY:
For popular events, {当日券|とうじつけん} may:
- Sell out quickly
- Not be available at all
- Be limited in quantity

RELATED TERMS:
- {前売|まえう}り{券|けん} / {前売券|ぜんばいけん} (advance ticket)
- {整理券|せいりけん} (numbered ticket for queueing)
- チケット (ticket)
- {入場券|にゅうじょうけん} (admission ticket)

RELATED:
- {前売|まえう}り (advance sale)
- {即売|そくばい} (immediate sale)
- {売|う}り{切|き}れ (sold out)
